text: 追番 · dsh-anime 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的动漫追看插件，在侧边栏提供独立主面板。它把番剧数据库、排播、在线播放与种子播放接入同一界面，支持季度浏览、搜索、个人追番、详情和播放器设置。宿主端通过本地 API 路由连接数据源，页面可选择 AniList、Bangumi、Animeko 等目录，并管理下载与片源。适合想在 DSH 内查找、追看和播放动漫的用户；不需要额外配置即可使用默认数据源，ffmpeg、mpv 和 qBittorrent 可按需安装。

dsh-anime adds an anime page to the DSH web client for seasonal listings, schedules, search, a watchlist, online streams, and torrents. Its host routes connect providers, and playback settings are built in. Browse without setup; ffmpeg, mpv, and qBittorrent are optional.
想在 DSH 里查看本季度有哪些新番。
我想按星期查未来几天的番剧排播。

想给正在看的番剧记下追番进度。
在 DSH 里怎么找可以在线播放的番剧？
我想用种子源播放某一集动漫。
I want to browse this season’s anime inside DSH.
Can I search anime and play a stream from one page?
dsh-anime 的「季度与排播浏览」功能：在主面板切换新番、放送表和搜索页面，并选择 AniList、Bangumi、Animeko 或 AniCh 等数据源查看番剧资料。
dsh-anime 的「本地追番表」功能：从番剧页面将作品加入追番列表，并在列表中记录已看集数与进度，便于继续追看。
dsh-anime 的「在线播放」功能：选择在线片源与线路后播放单集；宿主会在候选线路间尝试，并把视频流提供给页面播放器。
dsh-anime 的「种子播放」功能：搜索种子并选择文件，通过内置 WebTorrent 或配置的 qBittorrent 获取媒体，提供支持 Range 的播放流。
dsh-anime 的「播放器与下载设置」功能：选择内置或外部播放方式、种子引擎、缓存目录与下载位置；设置保存在 DSH 的插件状态目录中。

git clone https://github.com/Elisoar111/dsh-anime.git
cd dsh-anime
npm install          # 运行时只依赖 webtorrent
```

在 profile 的 `package.json` 加一条依赖 + 一条 bundle，路径改成你 clone 的位置：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@local/dsh-anime": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-anime"
  },

```bash
dsh --profile desktop plugin install     # 让 pnpm 建好链接
```

profile 文件位置：`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/package.json`，
Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`。

@local/dsh-anime README · 可选外部依赖：| 工具 | 用在哪 | 没有会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ffmpeg` | 在线流转码（HLS → fMP4）、种子下载合流 | 在线流播不了；种子流只能「用播放器打开」 |
| `mpv` | 外置播放「用播放器打开」 | 少一个入口，内置播放器不受影响 |
| `qBittorrent` | 把种子任务交给外部客户端 | 只能用内置 BT 引擎 |

> 装好之后**只有 AniList 是开着的**，其它源需要自己到「片源」里打开——见下一节。

@local/dsh-anime README · 首次打开：只有一个源是开着的：九个内置源里除 AniList 外全部 `defaultEnabled: false`，AnimeFlow 的声明式源（`src-*`）同样默认关闭。
这样新用户可以先把页面跑起来，再按需要开源，而不是一屏十几张卡全是「未配置 / 网络不通」。

打开方式：「片源」→ 找到对应卡片 → 右下角开关。开关状态会写进
`$DSH_HOME/state/dsh-anime/settings.json` 的 `extensions.<id>.enabled`，之后就算你改这个源的偏好设置也不会被悄悄改回去
（这一点有 `dev/check-default-sources.mjs` 守着）。

text:
@local/dsh-anime README · 数据源：| 源 | 提供什么 | 网络现状（实测） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **AniList** `graphql.anilist.co` | 季度新番、热度、放送时间轴、搜索、详情（角色 / 关联 / 制作组 / 预告）、观看顺序 | 可用，1–8 秒 |
| **Bangumi** `api.bgm.tv` / 镜像 `bgmapi.anibt.net` | 每周放送表、中文搜索、按季度搜番、详情 / 集数 / 收藏 | 官方地址连接超时；数据接口默认走 anibt 镜像（可用）。**OAuth 登录仍指 `bgm.tv`**，镜像没有代理该端点，所以收藏同步需要自备代理 |
| **Animeko** `api.animeko.org` | 季度排期、放送表、搜索、条目详情；封面 `static.myani.org` | 可用，匿名免 token，1–2 秒；条目 id 与 Bangumi 同一 id 空间 |
| **哔哩哔哩** `api.bilibili.com` | 在线流（番剧 + 用户投稿）、主题曲第二源 | 可用；无 cookie 会 412 风控，宿主先取 `buvid3/buvid4` 再请求 |
| **FQDM** | 在线流（MacCMS 模板站） | 可用；线路表 `{name, sid, count}`，部分线路 CDN 已死（见「死线路自动换线」） |
| **AniCh** `ani.emmmm.eu.org` | 在线流（站点解析）+ 索引（季度 / 搜索 / 详情 / 集数） | 可用；解析出的 15 条线路里混着小红书 CDN 的宣传片，需要按域名过滤 |
| **AniBT** `anibt.net` | 种子流首选，中文字幕组 | 可用，1–4 秒 |
| **AnimeTosho** `animetosho.org` | 种子流兜底（HTML 解析） | 可用，但不少 tracker 已死 |
| **AnimeFlow 声明式源** `assets/sources/animeflow` | `src-girigiri` / `src-gpjda` / `src-mxdm` 等，规则驱动的在线源 | 取决于站点 |
| **Seanime Marketplace**（jsDelivr 镜像） | 「片源」页列出上游生态的在线流 / 种子流 provider（本次实测 71 + 28 个，随上游清单变化） | GitHub raw 不可达，走 jsDelivr |

@local/dsh-anime README · 数据源：所有上游都由**宿主代理并缓存**（短期 60 秒 / 中期 10 分钟 / 片源目录 6 小时）：浏览器直连会撞 CORS 与
Referer 防盗链，宿主侧没有这些限制，也不把上游 URL 暴露给页面。

@local/dsh-anime README · 中文名是怎么补的：AniList 只有罗马字 / 日文 / 英文标题，选它时海报墙天然是英文。宿主做了一层**中文名映射**：
条目自带的 `title.native` 若是中文（有汉字、无假名）直接用；否则去 Animeko 同一季排期表
（`/v1/schedule/season/{id}` 与 `/v1/schedule/airing`）建 `name + aliases` 索引做**精确**匹配。
只有精确命中才改名——早先试过「Animeko 搜索取第一条」，把「薬屋のひとりごと」配成了
「BanG Dream! 第三季」，比留着英文更糟，已废弃。索引缓存 6 小时；仍没命中的保留原名。

想要 100% 中文，切到 **Animeko** 数据源（它自带 `nameCn`）。

@local/dsh-anime README · PrismFlow（默认引擎）：自研播放器组件：哔哩哔哩的 DASH 视频轨 / 音频轨由页面自己做 MSE 合流，字幕走 libass（真 ASS 渲染，
字体 / 字号 / 颜色 / 描边 / 阴影都在设置里改，落成服务端生成的 `[V4+ Styles]`），画面可选 Anime4K 锐化 / 超分。
不依赖外部进程，也不占独立窗口。

- 设置 → 播放 →「播放引擎」：`PrismFlow`（默认）或 `内嵌 mpv`（原生渲染，Anime4K 走 mpv 的 `--glsl-shaders-append`）。
- 同一套控制栏也用在别处：番剧、种子流、主题曲（OP/ED）播放器都是它，所以预加载段、清晰度菜单、
  键盘快捷键、画中画的表现一致。

@local/dsh-anime README · 在线流：1. 搜索：`/bili/search`、`/online/search`（FQDM / AniCh / `src-*` 走统一抽象）。
2. 集数：`/bili/season`、`/online/episodes`。
3. 解析：`/online/resolve` 内部完成；宿主带 `Referer` 拉流并**透传 Range**（206）。
4. 播放：`<video>`/MSE 读 `/online/stream`，或转码链路 `/torrent/transcode`。

**死线路自动换线**：`streamCandidates()` 会先问扩展要候选。FQDM 这类 MacCMS 站点的 `sid` 是每部番一份，
换线必须**重写集数 id**而不是只换名字（`lib/fqdm.js` 的 `alternates()`）；AniCh 的候选是画质档位。
候选按「用户点的那条 → 其余 → 记忆过能播的」排序，最多试 6 条，能播过的记进 `goodLine`。
（能播的线路常在列表第 5～11 位，只试三条时经常三条全死。）

@local/dsh-anime README · 在线流：**广告线路过滤**：AniCh 的 `/vod/{id}/{ep}` 里 `全集(全高清-1080P)` 那几条实际指向小红书 CDN 的宣传片，
宿主按域名丢掉，免得 ffmpeg 报 `not in allowed_segment_extensions` 或播出一段广告。

**清晰度**：哔哩哔哩走 qn 阶梯（4K / 1080P+ / 720P / 480P / 360P），换档时把当前秒数通过 `startAt` 带回去，
不回到片头；没有 caption 的源（FQDM / AniCh）档位名直接用站点给的真实线路名，而不是编一个「线路 3」。

@local/dsh-anime README · 种子流：- 默认**内置引擎**（`webtorrent`），加入磁力时**不能传 `announce: []`**，否则会覆盖磁力自带的 tracker，
  而本网络 DHT 不可靠，元数据永远拿不到。元数据通常 4–20 秒。
- `/torrent/stream?hash=&index=`：从 swarm 读文件、支持 Range（206）；元数据未就绪立刻返回
  **409 `metadata-pending`**，不让请求挂死。
- 播不了的编码（HEVC / 10bit / AV1）走 `/torrent/transcode`，ffmpeg 重封装或转码后再推给播放器。
- 也可切到 **qBittorrent**（`/api/v2`，`auth/login` 取 SID，403 自动重登重放）。
- 「用播放器打开」把流 URL 交给本机 mpv / VLC / PotPlayer（自动探测），并带上当前秒数与标题。

@local/dsh-anime README · 进度条、跳转与 fMP4：在线流的 fMP4 片段没有容器时长，因此这类流的总长显示 `--:--`、进度条不可拖——这是流本身的限制，
不是播放器的 bug。插件对能拿到时长的链路（转码、种子流、哔哩哔哩 DASH 的 `duration`）会显示真实长度；
哔哩哔哩的分段 DASH 没有索引表，拖动 = **换一条从目标秒开始的流**（`/bili/stream?…&start=秒`，
宿主用 ffmpeg `-ss` 起拼），页面把「已跳过多少秒」记在 `offset` 里，进度条显示 `offset + 流内秒数`。

拖动时用独立的 scrub 状态，松手才落回真实位置，不会被 `timeupdate` 抢回去；`±85s`、`←/→`、`A/D`
与进度条共用同一条 seek 路径。ffmpeg 转码流不支持 Range，那条链路上进度条是禁用的。

@local/dsh-anime README · 外部播放器与画质增强：播放器面板里的齿轮会列出本机检测到的 mpv / VLC / PotPlayer，点一下就把流交给它，并带上当前秒数
（mpv `--start=`、VLC `--start-time=`、PotPlayer `/seek=`）与本集标题。
section: 外部播放器与画质增强

text:
@local/dsh-anime README · 外部播放器与画质增强：- **Anime4K**：`off / 快速 / 均衡 / 高质量`，着色器随插件发布在 `assets/anime4k/`（49 个 `.glsl`），
  以 `--glsl-shaders-append=` 逐条交给 mpv；预设只用 `Restore_CNN_*` + `Upscale_CNN_x2_*` + `Clamp_Highlights`，
  GAN / UL / VL 在 1080p 实时解码下撑不住。VLC 与 PotPlayer 没有等价机制。
- **自定义命令**：设置里填模板即可接管播放器选择，占位符 `{url}` `{start}` `{title}` `{shaders}`。
- **内嵌 mpv**：`mpv --wid=<窗口句柄> --geometry=<面板矩形>` 直接画在面板区域，再走 `--input-ipc-server`
  把播放 / 暂停 / ±30s / 速度 / 音量 / 位置接回面板（`lib/mpv.js`）。拿不到窗口句柄时退化成独立窗口。
section: 外部播放器与画质增强

text:
@local/dsh-anime README · 追番与详情：- **追番表**存在浏览器 `localStorage`（`dsh-anime:watchlist:v1`），不联网、不占宿主状态。
- **详情页**头部：横幅、封面、标题、别名、评分 / 类型 / 放送状态 / 季度 / 集数 / 制作组 / 来源、追番按钮、
  AniList 外链、预告、下一话倒计时。
- **观看顺序**（`anilist/watchorder`）：按 AniList 的 `relations` 拓扑排序给出「前作 → 本作 → 续作」链，
  当前番剧高亮，每一行带封面、类型、集数、年份；点任意一条跳到那部作品的详情，可层层返回。
- **角色与关联**：角色卡（声优、性别、年龄、生日、血型、简介）+ 关联作品。

@local/dsh-anime README · 主题曲（OP / ED）：详情页的「主题曲」标签里是**来源切换**（选中哪个才查哪个），默认 animethemes：

| 来源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| animethemes.moe | 按 AniList id 取官方 OP/ED 片段（`/animethemes/themes`）。注意 `filter[has][]=resources` 这类**数组写法是必须的**，标量会被判 `The filter.resource must be an array` |
| 哔哩哔哩 | 复用 `bili/videos` 搜索 + `bili/video` 取 cid + `bili/stream` 代取字节，按视频标题搜「番名 OP」 |

本机 `api.animethemes.moe` 常被 Cloudflare 挑战（403 / 422 / 500），页面会把真实失败原因原文显示出来，

@local/dsh-anime README · 架构：**路由表是进程级的**：宿主不允许同一 exact 路由注册两次，而插件会被反复 `apply()`（重载、切面板、
第二实例）。所以每条路径在进程里只注册一次，注册的是转发器——它每次请求都从进程级表
（`globalThis[Symbol.for('dsh-anime.routes')]`）里取「最新一次 apply 发布的处理器」。
每次 apply 会在日志留一行 `routes published: N handlers … build <号>`，
页头出现「宿主需重启」标签说明 Host 与 Client 的 `EXPECTED_BUILD` 对不上。

**扩展即插件**：数据源、种子流、在线流三种扩展走同一个注册表，页面只读 manifest 就能画出卡片、
开关和偏好弹窗；关掉的扩展对应路由直接回「已停用」。AnimeFlow 的声明式源也注册成扩展（`src-*`）。

@local/dsh-anime README · Data sources：Every upstream is **proxied and cached by the host** (short-term 60 seconds / mid-term 10 minutes / Sources catalogue 6 hours): a browser hitting them directly runs into CORS and
Referer hotlink protection, while the host side has neither limitation and does not expose the upstream URL to the page either.

@local/dsh-anime README · How the Chinese titles are filled in：AniList only has romanised / Japanese / English titles, so the poster wall is naturally English when it is selected. The host does one layer of **Chinese title mapping**:
if the entry's own `title.native` is Chinese (has Han characters, no kana) it is used directly; otherwise the host goes to Animeko's schedule for the same season
(`/v1/schedule/season/{id}` and `/v1/schedule/airing`) and builds a `name + aliases` index for **exact** matching.
A title is only renamed on an exact hit — an earlier attempt at "take the first Animeko search result" mapped「薬屋のひとりごと」onto
「BanG Dream! 第三季」, which is worse than keeping the English title, so it was dropped. The index is cached for 6 hours; titles that still miss keep their original name.

text:
@local/dsh-anime README · Online stream：1. Search: `/bili/search`, `/online/search` (FQDM / AniCh / `src-*` go through one shared abstraction).
2. Episodes: `/bili/season`, `/online/episodes`.
3. Resolve: done internally by `/online/resolve`; the host pulls the stream with a `Referer` and **passes Range through** (206).
4. Playback: `<video>`/MSE reads `/online/stream`, or the transcoding path `/torrent/transcode`.

@local/dsh-anime README · Online stream：**Automatic dead-route switching**: `streamCandidates()` first asks the extension for candidates. On MacCMS sites such as FQDM the `sid` is per show, so switching a route must
**rewrite the episode id** rather than just swap the name (`alternates()` in `lib/fqdm.js`); for AniCh the candidates are quality tiers.
Candidates are ordered "the one the user clicked → the rest → lines remembered as playable", at most 6 are tried, and the ones that played are remembered in `goodLine`.
(Playable lines are often at positions 5–11 of the list, so when only three are tried all three are frequently dead.)

@local/dsh-anime README · Online stream：**Ad-route filtering**: a few `全集(全高清-1080P)` entries in AniCh's `/vod/{id}/{ep}` actually point at promo clips on a Xiaohongshu CDN; the host drops them by domain so that ffmpeg does not
report `not in allowed_segment_extensions` or play a stretch of advert.

@local/dsh-anime README · Online stream：**Quality**: bilibili uses the qn ladder (4K / 1080P+ / 720P / 480P / 360P), and switching tier carries the current second back through `startAt`
instead of returning to the opening; for sources without captions (FQDM / AniCh) the tier names are the real route names the site provides, instead of an invented "Route 3".

@local/dsh-anime README · Torrent stream：- The **built-in engine** (`webtorrent`) is the default; when adding a magnet you **must not pass `announce: []`**, because that overwrites the trackers that come with the magnet,
  and DHT is unreliable on this network, so the metadata would never arrive. Metadata usually takes 4–20 seconds.
- `/torrent/stream?hash=&index=`: reads the file from the swarm and supports Range (206); while the metadata is not ready it immediately returns
  **409 `metadata-pending`**, so the request does not hang.
- Encodings that cannot be played (HEVC / 10bit / AV1) go through `/torrent/transcode`, where ffmpeg remuxes or transcodes before pushing the stream to the player.
- You can also switch to **qBittorrent** (`/api/v2`, `auth/login` to obtain the SID, automatic re-login and replay on 403).
- "Open with player" hands the stream URL to the local mpv / VLC / PotPlayer (auto-detected), together with the current second and the title.

@local/dsh-anime README · Progress bar, seeking and fMP4：Dragging uses a separate scrub state, and the real position is only restored when you let go, so `timeupdate` cannot snatch it back; `±85s`, `←/→`, `A/D`
and the progress bar all share the same seek path. ffmpeg transcoded streams do not support Range, and on that path the progress bar is disabled.

@local/dsh-anime README · External players and picture enhancement：The gear in the player panel lists the mpv / VLC / PotPlayer detected on this machine; one click hands the stream over to it, together with the current second
(mpv `--start=`, VLC `--start-time=`, PotPlayer `/seek=`) and the current episode title.

@local/dsh-anime README · External players and picture enhancement：- **Anime4K**: `off / Fast / Balanced / High quality`; the shaders ship with the plugin in `assets/anime4k/` (49 `.glsl` files) and are handed to mpv one by one
  via `--glsl-shaders-append=`; the presets use only `Restore_CNN_*` + `Upscale_CNN_x2_*` + `Clamp_Highlights`, because
  GAN / UL / VL cannot keep up with real-time 1080p decoding. VLC and PotPlayer have no equivalent mechanism.
- **Custom command**: fill in a template in Settings and it takes over player selection; the placeholders are `{url}` `{start}` `{title}` `{shaders}`.
- **Embedded mpv**: `mpv --wid=<window handle> --geometry=<panel rect>` draws directly into the panel area, and `--input-ipc-server` then wires
  play / pause / ±30s / speed / volume / position back to the panel (`lib/mpv.js`). When the window handle cannot be obtained it degrades to a separate window.

@local/dsh-anime README · Watchlist and details：- The **watchlist** lives in the browser's `localStorage` (`dsh-anime:watchlist:v1`); it needs no network and takes no host state.
- The **Details** header: banner, cover, title, aliases, score / genres / airing status / season / episode count / studios / source, the watchlist button,
  the AniList external link, the trailer, and the countdown to the next episode.
- **Watch order** (`anilist/watchorder`): a topological sort over AniList's `relations` produces a "prequel → this → sequel" chain,
  with the current show highlighted and each row carrying cover, format, episode count and year; clicking any row jumps to that work's details, and you can go back level by level.
- **Characters and relations**: character cards (voice actor, gender, age, birthday, blood type, description) + related works.
@local/dsh-anime README · Theme songs (OP / ED)：The Themes tab on the Details page is a **source switch** (only the selected source is queried), with animethemes as the default:

@local/dsh-anime README · Theme songs (OP / ED)：| Source | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| animethemes.moe | Fetches the official OP/ED clips by AniList id (`/animethemes/themes`). Note that an **array form such as** `filter[has][]=resources` **is mandatory**; a scalar is rejected with `The filter.resource must be an array` |
| bilibili | Reuses `bili/videos` for search + `bili/video` to get the cid + `bili/stream` to fetch the bytes, searching "show name OP" against video titles |
@local/dsh-anime README · Downloads：Both sources share one task table, files land in the system "Downloads" folder by default, and the history is written to `downloads.json`:

@local/dsh-anime README · Downloads：- **Online stream**: the download icon at the bottom right of the player → `/downloads/stream`; the host fetches the stream with its own `Referer`/Cookie,
  writes `name.mp4.part` first and then renames it. **The output is handed to ffmpeg by extension** (when writing `.part` it cannot recognise the container and reports
  `Unable to find a suitable output format`), so it really is writing `.part` plus an explicit `-f mp4`.
- **Torrent stream**: `/downloads/torrent`; the host polls the engine's progress and copies the finished file into the download folder.
- Both have progress, speed, cancel (cancel deletes the `.part`), and open containing folder; the interface follows Motrix's task rows / progress bars / status badges.
- The download folder can be set in three ways: type a path, "Browse…" (the host prefers Electron's `dialog.showOpenDialog` and falls back to
  PowerShell + WinForms), or "Use default". It can also be overridden with the `DSH_ANIME_DOWNLOAD_DIR` environment variable.

@local/dsh-anime README · Architecture：**The route table is process-level**: the host does not allow the same exact route to be registered twice, yet the plugin is `apply()`ed repeatedly (reload, panel switch,
second instance). So each path is registered only once per process, and what gets registered is a forwarder — on every request it takes "the handler published by the most recent apply"
from the process-level table (`globalThis[Symbol.for('dsh-anime.routes')]`).
Every apply leaves one line in the log, `routes published: N handlers … build <number>`,
and a "Host restart required"（宿主需重启）tag in the page header means the Host's and the Client's `EXPECTED_BUILD` do not match.

@local/dsh-anime README · Architecture：**An extension is a plugin**: the three kinds of extension — data source, torrent stream, online stream — go through the same registry, and the page only has to read the manifest to draw the cards,
the toggles and the preferences dialog; routes belonging to a switched-off extension simply answer "disabled". AnimeFlow's declarative sources are registered as extensions as well (`src-*`).

@local/dsh-anime README · Known limitations：- **Bangumi OAuth**: the data endpoints can go through the mirror, but the login endpoint `bgm.tv/oauth/access_token` is not proxied by the mirror,
  so you need your own proxy or a self-hosted reverse proxy.
- **animethemes.moe**: often blocked by Cloudflare on this machine, so Themes ends up on bilibili by default.
- **Online-stream fMP4 has no container duration**: total length `--:--` and the progress bar cannot be dragged; paths that do have a `duration` behave normally.
- **Torrent tracker quality**: many public trackers are dead, and AnimeTosho results often contain entries with 0 seeders.
- **AniCh registration** needs an email verification code; the plugin only provides the entry point and never sends it on your behalf.

@local/dsh-anime README · License and third-party：Data comes from public APIs such as [AniList](https://anilist.co), [Bangumi](https://bgm.tv), [Animeko](https://animeko.org),
[bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com); the plugin only aggregates and plays on the client side and hosts no content.

The interface and interactions take inspiration from [Seanime](https://github.com/5rahim/seanime) (extensions / Sources catalogue / player interactions) and
[Motrix](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix) (download list).
